_comment: Casting sheet: speaker (as used in lines.json) → ElevenLabs voice preferences, first match wins. Entries may be voice NAMES from the account's voice list or raw voice IDs (IDs work even with TTS-only scoped keys). Add a character: add its speaker here + write its lines in lines.json → next deploy voices it. Env overrides NARRATOR_VOICE / WIZARD_VOICE / MAYOR_VOICE still take precedence.
